content.short: Mirror is a Web3 publishing platform like Medium that uses blockchain-based encryption, with free publishing and only an Ethereum wallet required.
content.description: Mirror is a Web3 publishing platform similar to Medium, built on blockchain-based encryption. Publishing is free and only requires an Ethereum wallet to get started. The Mirror Dashboard provides extensive utilities and, once you sign up, you have broad flexibility to create blog posts. You can also set a custom URL (___mirror.xyz) by burning one of Mirror's tokens and receiving a community vote. The platform supports Ethereum, Multichain, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Polygon.
